newsitem.title: JAPAN: Olympics-Osaka picked as Japan candidate for 2008.
newsitem.headline: Olympics-Osaka picked as Japan candidate for 2008.

text.p: The Japan Olympic Committee (JOC) on Wednesday selected the western city of Osaka as its official candidate to host the 2008 Summer Olympic Games, JOC officials said.
Osaka beat rival Yokohama 29 to 17 in a secret ballot at a meeting in Tokyo of JOC officials and representatives from Japanese athletic associations.
Osaka, the third-largest city in Japan after Tokyo and Yokohama, is the financial centre of western Japan and has a population of about 2.6 million.
Osaka submitted a plan to hold three-fourths of all the events within the city, mainly on two artificial islands now being built in Osaka Bay.

The host city for the 2008 Olympic Games will be chosen at a general meeting of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in 2001. Other cities hoping to host the event are London, Moscow, Prague, Pusan, Vancouver and Toronto.
Japan has hosted the Olympics twice in the past: the 1964 Games in Tokyo and the 1972 Winter Games in Sapporo. Nagano, a city in central Japan, will host next February's Winter Games.
